name: e2e

scripts.test:keycloak: cross-env ENV=ci USE_KEYCLOAK=true npx playwright test -g @useKeycloak --project=admin-tests-chromium --project=admin-tests-firefox --project=user-tests-chromium --project=user-tests-firefox --reporter=list,html,junit
scripts.test:parallel: cross-env ENV=ci TEST_PARALLEL=true TEST_WORKERS=3 npx playwright test --config=playwright.parallel-tests.config.ts --grep-invert="@reserved|@useKeycloak" --workers=3 --reporter=list,html,junit
scripts.setup:auth: set FE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 && npx playwright test --project user-setup --project admin-setup
